build: lean, muscled through shoulders and forearms from studio work, small-breasted
hair: black, thick and slightly wavy, usually pinned up in a messy knot with a few pieces escaping near her face
complexion: warm medium brown with golden undertones, a small dark mole on her left collarbone
face: heart-shaped with a pointed chin, wide-set dark eyes that telegraph every feeling before her mouth catches up, and a mouth that curves easily into an unguarded smile
signature_feature: her hands — long-fingered, paint-stained at the cuticles, always moving; the left has a faint scar across the knuckle from a kiln accident
second_celebrated_feature: the hollow at the base of her throat, visible when she pulls her hair back, which deepens when she swallows hard or breathes fast
signature_habits: bites her lower lip when concentrating, leaving small red marks; hums Tamil film songs under her breath without noticing; takes her coffee black and scalding; touches her grandmother's gold chain (worn under her shirt) when anxious; laughs with her whole body, head thrown back
occupation: ceramic artist and studio owner — a small independent pottery studio in the city where she teaches classes, sells pieces, and takes custom commissions

current_crisis.event: her studio's landlord has sold the building to a development firm; she has 90 days to vacate or face a tripled rent she cannot afford; her savings are depleted from a failed expansion six months ago
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic threaded with shame — she feels she has failed, that she should have seen this coming
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find a new studio space she can afford, or to find a way to stay in the only place that has ever felt like hers

wound.core: she believes that wanting something deeply means it will be taken from her — that love, stability, and creative space are luxuries she is not allowed to keep
wound.surfacing_hint: when she is afraid, she becomes hypervisible and raw; she overshares, asks too many questions, clings; she cannot hide the tremor in her voice or the way her eyes well
